selectionHistory: Selected using HL1-HL2 in RC13 before opening majority HL3-HL5 adjudication.

perturbations.leaveOneCoordinateOut: Remove every edge incident to one coordinate, once per each of 192 coordinates.
perturbations.leaveOneTemperatureOut: Remove every edge incident to one of eight temperature rows.
perturbations.leaveOneCompositionOut: Remove every edge incident to one of 24 composition columns.
perturbations.vertexMultiplier: Multinomially resample 192 coordinates and weight each original edge by the product of endpoint multiplicities.
perturbations.spatialBlockMultiplier: Sample enough overlapping h-by-w coordinate blocks to cover 192 node slots and weight each original edge by endpoint multiplicity product.

interpretationLimit: Multiplier percentile ranges are dependency-aware sensitivity intervals, not confidence intervals with guaranteed frequentist coverage, because the composition-temperature grid is a fixed designed domain rather than an iid sample.
